TRIP_Evidence: Bulk SXRD Rietveld shows ε-HCP fraction rising from ~33% initially to nearly 77% at fracture; TRIP starts when γ-FCC yields and continues through the tensile test.
TWIP_Evidence: Peak-intensity splitting and 1° cake integrations identify ε-HCP tensile twinning onset at ~530 MPa and compression twinning onset at ~655 MPa.
Slip_Evidence: Dislocation density rises strongly in γ-FCC and in ε-HCP; authors identify slip in both phases throughout plastic loading.
Mechanism_Phase_Scope: TRIP: γ-FCC→ε-HCP. TWIP: ε-HCP tensile/compression twinning. γ-FCC twinning is not identified.
Notes: Condition-level targets are 1/1/1. Stage chronology must be preserved because mechanisms activate sequentially.
